mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; Barrot V3 remains execution and verification foundation.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI Holdings completed the full acquisition of Bitbank on October 1, 2026; Bitbank became a wholly owned SBI Holdings subsidiary through SBICAH GK.
CoinGecko's Bitbank market page displayed an XRP/JPY pair with approximately $7.54M 24-hour volume, 0.01% spread and asymmetric ±2% depth of about $354k bid-side and $915k ask-side at the capture.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Third-party single snapshot; no exact exchange timestamp.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI VC Trade announced a Visa crypto card whose points can be automatically exchanged into BTC, ETH or XRP and credited through an SBI VC Trade account.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Aggregate XRP credited and current promotional campaign eligibility are unknown.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI START bond sold out; official SBI Securities page shows JPY 10B issue, 2.150% annual coupon and A- rating. Eligible JPY 100,000+ buyers were offered JPY 200-equivalent XRP per JPY 100,000, subject to account/eligibility conditions.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Actual XRP distribution total not published; later coupon-date rewards undecided and not promised.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank issues JPYSC and manages its trust backing; SBI VC Trade distributes it; Startale co-developed it. Initial service was limited to SBI VC Trade account balances pending legal/tax readiness for public-chain circulation.
JPYSC outstanding issuance was approximately JPY 20.1B on September 7, with JPY 1.0B of trust backing allocated to short-term JGBs and JPY 6.9B of lending applications.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Lending applications are not additional issued supply.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI and Startale joined Open Standard on October 16 and are considering a JPYSC/OUSD interoperability proof of concept.
confirmed_facts.qualification: No live bridge, chain route or production settlement is established.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI, Startale and BlackRock signed an October 27 basic agreement to explore tokenized MMF and JPYSC use.
confirmed_facts.qualification: MOU/exploration only; no named fund or production deployment.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI announced a planned merger of SBI Clearing Trust into SBI Shinsei Trust Bank effective December 31, subject to regulatory approvals; SBI Clearing Trust began crypto-asset trust services in July 2023.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Merger not yet effective and not an XRP-specific custody announcement.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI VC Trade distributes RLUSD since June 24, 2026 and had offered USDC since March 2025.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Availability does not establish volumes or stablecoin market-share changes.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBI Ripple Asia announced technical support for startups implementing XRPL-based financial services.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Support agreement does not prove each startup launched or generated XRP demand.

confirmed_facts.claim: SBICAH GK and SBI Crypto Asset Holdings Co., Ltd. are part of the SBI crypto-asset holding/acquisition structure and are distinct from SBIC East Japan.
confirmed_facts.qualification: The intended meaning of the user's bare acronym SBIC remains unresolved.

confirmed_facts.claim: OUSD launched through Stripe products on September 30 and is available on Base, Ethereum, Solana and Tempo; Open Standard's founding partners include Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa.
The Block reported Ripple among Open Standard's broader network participants.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Network participation does not make Ripple the OUSD issuer or establish a direct bilateral agreement with Coinbase.

confirmed_facts.claim: CoinLaw's Binance PoR summary displays BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC ratios but no XRP ratio.
confirmed_facts.qualification: Does not prove XRP is absent from Binance's complete official PoR report.

sourced_claims.claim: Bitquery says all 17 drained hot wallets carried Binance PoR labels in its address data.
sourced_claims.qualification: Provider address labels, not official Binance-signed crosswalk.

sourced_claims.claim: CoinDesk's October 1 PoR review identifies Ethereum Binance 14 but does not identify the five XRPL source addresses.
CoinDesk reports institutional withdrawals from centralized exchanges after the Binance incident.
sourced_claims.qualification: Anonymous-source claim with no amounts, destinations or XRP-specific attribution.

inferences.claim: SBI is building a multi-rail digital-asset stack: XRP distribution and XRPL support coexist with JPYSC, USDC, RLUSD, OUSD interoperability, tokenized MMF exploration and consolidated trust/custody plans.
inferences.basis: Multiple official SBI releases. This is a group-level strategic inference; no single integrated production architecture is disclosed.

inferences.claim: Bitbank's acquisition gives SBI control of an additional Japanese XRP/JPY spot venue and customer base.
inferences.basis: Acquisition completion and XRP/JPY market listing. Incremental volume, customer migration and post-acquisition liquidity effects remain unmeasured.

inferences.claim: SBI's card and bond incentives create retail XRP distribution paths that do not require users to initiate a standalone XRP purchase.
inferences.basis: Official product terms. Total XRP credited, net exchange acquisition and ongoing activity remain unknown.

inferences.claim: JPYSC/OUSD and the BlackRock tokenized-MMF MOU may establish alternative JPY/USD and tokenized-collateral routes alongside RLUSD/USDC.
inferences.basis: Official PoC/MOU announcements. No live interoperability or XRP settlement is established.

inferences.claim: Open Standard's shared partner-economics model could challenge issuer-centric stablecoin economics used by Circle, while Coinbase and Ripple participate in the broader network.
inferences.basis: Official Stripe OUSD launch and secondary reporting of Ripple's participation. No evidence yet of USDC displacement or Circle revenue loss.

unknowns: Actual XRP spot volume, customer balances and net acquisitions at Bitbank after SBI's October 1 acquisition.
Aggregate XRP credited through the SBI VISA Crypto Card and the SBI START bond reward.
Whether the SBI Clearing Trust merger receives all required approvals and whether the surviving trust bank will custody XRP specifically.
Whether JPYSC/OUSD interoperability will use a public chain, which chain/bridge is selected, and whether the PoC will enter production.
The specific BlackRock tokenized MMF, collateral eligibility, settlement chain, launch date and transaction volumes.
Actual RLUSD and USDC balances and flows through SBI VC Trade.
Whether Ripple's Open Standard participation involves any XRPL integration; no OUSD XRPL deployment is established.
Whether the five Binance XRPL source wallets appear in Binance's official October 1 PoR address set or the XRP-BF2 backing address.
Whether CoinLaw's omission of XRP reflects tracker scope or a different PoR asset set; official full address/asset payload still required.
